paragraphs.text: Isobel was an angel of Innistrad who was a part of The Flight of Alabaster led by Bruna .

Isobel expressed great concern over Avacyn's disappearance, asking any souls she heralded to the Blessed Sleep where their greatest angel had gone. Later driven to madness, Isobel joined Avacyn's rampage against the people of Innistrad and was consequently slain by the humans she once protected.
